'''Vasily Ivanovich Aksyonov''' ({{langx|ru|Василий Иванович Аксёнов}}; born 6 June 1957) is a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] and [[Russia]]n scientist in the field of [[nuclear physics]], [[Candidate of Sciences|сandidate of Sciences]].

== Biography ==
Aksyonov was born on 6 June 1957 in [[Tver Oblast]].

In 1981 he graduated from the [[Moscow Power Engineering Institute|Moscow Power Engineering]] Institute with a degree in Nuclear Power Plants and Installations.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.aer-rea.ru/files/user/press/rea/1.10.pdf|title=Калининская АЭС инженера Аксёнова|author=Вячеслав Степовой|website=|date=|publisher=|access-date=2018-05-22|archive-date=2018-02-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180228223333/http://www.aer-rea.ru/files/user/press/rea/1.10.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

After graduation, he began working at the [[Kalinin Nuclear Power Plant]]. He was a senior operator, senior reactor engineer, shift supervisor, reactor manager, chief engineer, deputy Kalinin NPP, in 2005 he was promoted to director.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.atomic-energy.ru/experts/aksenov-vasiliy-ivanovich|title=Аксенов Василий Иванович|date=2015-02-05|work=Атомная энергия 2.0|access-date=2018-05-22|language=ru}}</ref>

In 2007–2008, he held the post of Deputy Technical Director for the new blocks of [[Rosenergoatom|Rosenergoatom Concern]]. Since March 2008 - First Deputy General Director of OJSC Atomenergoremont. Since January 2015 - Director of the Moscow Center of the [[World Association of Nuclear Operators|World Association of Operators of Nuclear Power Plants]].<ref name="ZSTO 2018">{{Cite web|url=http://www.zsto.ru/?id=132&Itemid=22&option=com_content&view=article|title=Аксенов Василий Иванович|website=www.zsto.ru|language=en|access-date=2018-05-22|archive-date=2018-02-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180228223532/http://www.zsto.ru/?id=132&Itemid=22&option=com_content&view=article|url-status=dead}}</ref>

He was a deputy of the [[Legislative Assembly of Tver Oblast|Legislative Assembly of the Tver region]].<ref name="ZSTO 2018" />

He was awarded the medal of the [[Medal of the Order "For Merit to the Fatherland"|Order of Merit for the Fatherland]] II degree (2005).<ref name="ZSTO 2018" />
